subject: Launch orchestration manifest — MAP-embedded implementation plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@skybridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch orchestration manifest — MAP-embedded implementation plan

Hi Elena / Skybridge team,

Congrats again on signing — excited to get into execution. Attached is a first-pass "manifest" that embeds the post-signature implementation plan into the MAP you approved during contracting. High-level goals for this thread:

- Lock canary window and rollback gates
- Confirm migration cutover approach (in-place vs parallel)
- Finalize customer training dates and scope
- Assign Redwood owners for each MAP checkpoint

What I attached (v1.2):
- skybridge-map-v1.2.pdf — MAP with implementation milestones inline
- canary-checklist-skybridge.xlsx — canary runbook and acceptance criteria
- training-rollout-slides-v1.pptx — 2-hour training session outline + lab exercises

Quick asks: please confirm (by end of week):
1) Preferred canary week (we've penciled 9/11–9/15)
2) Migration preference: blue/green (parallel) or database cutover (in-place)?
3) Who from your ops team will be the runbook responder (name + contact)?

Internal note: Karthik — I left the rollout cadence as 4 weeks from canary to full traffic; feel free to tighten if Skybridge is ready. Monica — can you review the training scope and add a customer success checkpoint at T+1 week? Priyom — want you on the canary technical dry-run. Laura — we may need a slimmed-down fallback image for faster restore, flag if that's unrealistic.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Best,
Neha
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: skybridge-map-v1.2.pdf (PDF), canary-checklist-skybridge.xlsx (Excel), training-rollout-slides-v1.pptx (PowerPoint)

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@skybridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Martin Cole <martin.cole@skybridge.com>, Skybridge IT <it@skybridge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch orchestration manifest — MAP-embedded implementation plan

Thanks Neha — this looks comprehensive and in line with what leadership expects. A few clarifications from our side:

- Canary window: 9/11–9/15 works for us, but we need the canary to be limited to the "alpha" tenant group (we'll provide identifiers).
- Migration approach: we'd prefer blue/green parallel deployment to avoid a DDL window during business hours. Is that supported for our footprint (4 nodes, PostgreSQL 13)?
- Runbook owner: assigning Martin Cole (martin.cole@skybridge.com) as primary responder; cc'd.
- Training: can we do two 90-minute sessions (APAC-friendly times)? We'll have ~12 engineers + 4 ops on each.

One ask: can you include a short acceptance criteria matrix for the canary that maps to our SLIs? We need to show the board a measurable checklist.

Appreciate the attachments. We'll review the PDF and checklist internally and come back with comments by Friday.

Best,
Elena Morris
VP, Platform Operations
Skybridge

---
Attachments referenced: —

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@skybridge.com>, Martin Cole <martin.cole@skybridge.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Aug 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch orchestration manifest — MAP-embedded implementation plan

Looping in a proposed task plan from Redwood's side after reading Elena's note. Summary of owners and near-term deliverables: 

1) Canary acceptance criteria (owner: Priyom) — deliver by 2028-08-04
   - 6 SLIs mapped to pass/fail thresholds (latency P50/P95, error rate, tail CPU/GPU, cold-starts)
   - Automated smoke tests + synthetic load script

2) Blue/Green deployment play (owner: Laura) — deliver quick feasibility doc by 2028-08-06
   - Include time estimate to build fallback image and steps for DB cutover if needed

3) Training schedule + materials (owner: Monica) — propose two 90-min sessions and a 60-min office hours
   - Draft slides and labs due by 2028-08-08

4) MAP checkpoint calendar (owner: Neha) — publish the MAP with calendar invites by 2028-08-07

I flagged the canary week 9/11–9/15 as tentative until Skybridge confirms tenant scope. If blue/green is possible, we can shorten full-traffic ramp to 2 weeks after successful canary; otherwise, keep 4-week ramp.

Priyom — I'll need you to schedule a technical dry-run with Skybridge the week of 8/21; can you propose 2 slots? Laura — ping me if the fallback image ETA is >5 working days. Monica — think about a one-week post-training checklist (engagement survey + knowledge check).

Thanks — I'll assemble a single-run checklist and post a shared Confluence page (link to follow).

-Karthik
Senior Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@skybridge.com>, Martin Cole <martin.cole@skybridge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Aug 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch orchestration manifest — MAP-embedded implementation plan

Elena / Martin — thanks for the quick turn. Per Karthik's owners, I've attached a consolidated MAP manifest (PDF) and canary checklist (Excel) with inline acceptance criteria tied to SLIs. Links and highlights below: 

- Canary acceptance matrix: rows map to Skybridge SLIs (p50/p95 latency, error rate <0.5%, 99.9% availability for the test tenant). Each row has pass/fail and remediation step.
- Training plan: two 90-minute instructor-led sessions + 60-minute office hours on 9/19 (post-canary dry-run). Proposed session times: 06:00 PDT / 15:00 IST to cover APAC and US shifts.
- Cutover preference: blue/green recommended; Laura will confirm by 8/06 with a fallback cadence for DB changes.

Next steps (action items):
- Skybridge to confirm tenant alpha list and runbook contact (Martin) by EOD Friday 8/04
- Priyom to deliver canary acceptance matrix by 8/04 (attached draft in workbook)
- Laura to post blue/green feasibility by 8/06
- Neha to share calendar invites for MAP checkpoints by 8/07

Elena — attaching: skybridge-map-v1.2.pdf, canary-checklist-skybridge.xlsx, training-rollout-slides-v1.pptx

If everyone is aligned I will publish the Confluence page and create the HubSpot milestones for tracking.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
